sets.notes: KD Digital's Official Artist Channel presents this as Kinjal Dave's 2022 nonstop Trantali Garba album. The visible source page showed a 50:02 runtime, 4,429,429 views, and a Sep 20, 2022 publication date; its description credits producer Lalit Dave, singer Kinjal Dave, and music arrangement by Alpesh Panchal. Linked to the existing 23-track Killol 2.0 catalogue release. The description does not publish chapter timestamps, so the continuous video remains one full-set playback item without fabricated segment starts or separate chapter routes.
